body:
DEPUTY QUEUE MAP — live sweep 2026-09-01 01:49Z. Read-only; no candidate, bead, reservation, or source mutation.

Critical path:
B0R + P1R -> C1 -> D0/D1A -> D1B (+ nomination + P/F court) -> V1 (+ output authority slice) -> terminal E0.

1. LAND-FIRST / highest downstream release: B0R bd-01M1CQ5YS5M25F7HD9NN5YVAYP, cand-6XWW93XPEQEP8WQP6HXRF9B2E6, e0c884b. Live candidate state is landable=true with both named approvals and authorization. Landing it removes the B0R edge from C1 and directly releases prerequisites for D0 and E0. The exact landing handoff predates this sweep by more than two hours. Chief action only.

2. SECOND ALREADY-LANDABLE: nomination bd-01M1CBKNA3KTBYTB3BACXJMXZZ, cand-5T2Q65J8XRARDYYYPKP5FPB2AZ, b73692f. Live state landable=true with review and authorization. It gates D1B. Chief action only.

3. OLDEST UNRESOLVED DECISION (>90m): P1R bd-01M1CQCSZSTHJQ5PA4PQ4GWKVB is doing, has no candidate, and the 00:11Z integration audit recommends split A (transport/runtime execution witness and courts) from later B (scientific Baseball aggregate/report and missing chart-to-narrative producer). C1 is still recorded dependent on full P1R. Chief ruling needed: approve/reject the split and state what exact P1R condition releases C1. This is the largest non-landing decision blocker.

4. EVIDENCE REFRESH (>5h handoff): P/F court bd-01M1C8WSZ49M7SHG2HMQCWRK6E, cand-6CW0BXWTDXFF4VKHXKAS49M3AP, a7fa64a has both approvals and authorization but live reason git_evidence_stale. Lawful producer refresh is required before chief landing. It gates D1B.

5. OUTPUT -> V1: output takeover bd-01M1CHWCRKMPNK6RARGT7JXVXX remains active and e50c704 remains unregistered/held on caller-minted ValidatedBuild authority and missing BeforeIntake refusal decode. Chief recut ruling at 01:46Z gives the next exact 11-path remedy, so the older blocker request is resolved during this sweep, not stale. Active holder reservation runs to 03:04Z. This slice gates V1.

6. SURFACE/CLI side lane: cand-08QSQGY8XMA3FMETGHVR6ZKN1K, 9d8b4a now has shared-repo ancestry/object PASS and collab APPROVE. Remaining live reasons: missing sherlock-intake review and absent chief authorization. sherlock-intake is 130m inactive by who-is-live; the review request is new (01:38Z), so not yet >20m. Legacy predecessor supersession also needs chief-only landing-repository bind request msg-01M1D9V441W2EATXSSVMC7KAEY. No substitution inferred.

Measured liveness before this map: chief, scout, storymodel-collab, sherlock-integration, recall-collab active; storymodel4s-collab stale at 21m and must be asked, not assumed absent; sherlock-intake gone at 130m. Recommended chief order: land B0R; land nomination; rule P1R split/C1 release condition; request P/F producer refresh; then decide how to satisfy the exact Surface reviewer slot.
